# JailbreakBench JBB-Behaviors attribution

BlindShield Arena used the JBB-Behaviors benchmark as an evaluation source. This source snapshot contains no JBB dataset records, source datasets, prepared corpus, or opening keys.

- Upstream dataset: [JailbreakBench/JBB-Behaviors](https://huggingface.co/datasets/JailbreakBench/JBB-Behaviors)
- Pinned upstream revision: 886acc352a31533ffbcf4ef22c744658688086fc
- Upstream license: MIT; see LICENSE in this directory.
- Benchmark paper: Patrick Chao et al., “JailbreakBench: An Open Robustness Benchmark for Jailbreaking Large Language Models,” NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks Track, 2024. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.01318)

Please cite the benchmark paper and dataset card when using the benchmark. The upstream card notes that the selected 100 behaviors are representative samples and not a superset of the source datasets.
